sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.10491/2024 which is second application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant - Aslam on the ground of parity.

02. The appellant has been convicted Section 366-A, 34 of IPC and sentenced to undergo 3 years'
R.I. with fine of Rs.500/-, Section 376(D) of IPC and sentenced to undergo 20 years of R.I. with fine of Rs.5000/- and Section 16 & 17 of Prevention of Child from Sexual Offences, 2012 and sentenced to undergo 10 years' R.I. with fine of Rs.500/- with default stipulation.

entities.text: Prevention of Child from Sexual Offences, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 03. As per prosecution story, FIR was lodged by father of Prosecutrix that he saw co-accused Amin forcibly taking his daughter in his Maruti Van on 19.04.2021 at about 10:15.
Thereafter, she was subjected to sexual assault by Amin.
After recovery of the Prosecutrix, she disclosed the name of present appellant and co-accused-Lalu that he was also in the Van alongwith present appellant Aslam.
04. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that co-convict Lalu in Criminal Appeal No.9233/2023 has been granted suspension of jail sentence, therefore, he claims parity with the said convicts.
He further submits that at the most the case against the appellant would be made out under Section 366-A of 2 CRA-7824-2023 IPC and for that he has already undergone jail sentence of 3 years.
Also this appeal is not likely to come up for final hearing in near future, therefore, keeping in view the period of custody, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant may be suspended 05.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent / State opposes the aforesaid application and prays for its rejection.

sentences.text:
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the allegation against the present appellant that he was sitting in the van alongwith co-accused Lalu and the fact that the similarly placed co-convict Lalu has been granted suspension of jail sentence by order dated 13.03.2024 in Criminal Appeal No.9233/2023 as also the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties,
we are of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence moved on behalf of the appellant deserves to be allowed.

07. Accordingly, I.A. No.10491/2024, is allowed and it is directed that subject to depositing fine amount and on furnishing personal bond by the appellant -Aslam in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousands Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court and on deposit of fine amount (if not already deposited), the execution of custodial part of the jail sentence shall remain suspended, till the final disposal of this appeal.

The appellant after being enlarged on bail, shall mark his presence before the Registry of this Court on 12/11/2024 and on all such subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard.
List for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
